register.title: Evan Daniel's n308 certificate at bc0708f, issue689
register.headline: Daniel's smaller n308 packing, started from Chaoweeraprasit's 307 packing, certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its regularized view at the same side. The source reports a KKT local minimum strict modulo 47 exact flat motions, 242 corner-corner contacts with no corner-corner MILP descent, 5 rattlers and 102 tilted squares, in the family of #484 and #489 with 8 fewer tilted squares, and says it is not a refinement of #489: 295 load-bearing squares move by more than 1e-4 under its matching and no tilt angle is shared. Those are numerical evidence at 80 digits, as the source says, not proofs. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose chained explorer inserted one square into the register's s(307) packing, Nate Chaoweeraprasit's (itsnaka's) #481 packing (T-136), and whose basin explorer descended from there to this packing; the issue asks that #481's s(307) packing be credited as the ultimate start, and says the packing does not descend from Kevin Fang's #484 or Daniel's #489. The search, the checks and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code) under Evan Daniel's direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then adopt at 308.
